exposure: Early-life gut microbiota (16S rRNA gene sequencing)
outcome: Atopic dermatitis (AD) by one year of age
cohort: 18 infants from Beijing, China, with fecal samples collected at 42 days of age and followed for one year.
finding: Multi-omics profiling of the infant gut at 42 days identified specific microbial and metabolic features, such as reduced Staphylococcus abundance and lower levels of linoleic acid and choline phosphate, associated with later atopic dermatitis development by one year of age.
